workarounds.symptom: Instagram: Google fallback 404 turns a clean no-reels result back into an error (v3.31.0)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: clarify Instagram Google discovery failures. Target files: skills/last30days/scripts/lib/health.py, skills/last30days/scripts/lib/instagram.py, skills/last30days/scripts/lib/pipeline.py. When an empty Instagram reels search falls back to Google discovery and that request fails, `search_instagram` currently returns empty items with no error while Source Coverage receives a generic transport failure. This makes an unavailable discovery stage difficult to distinguish from a successful search with no reels. (Ref: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1362)

workarounds.symptom: Codex YOLO rejects plan-file cleanup before research starts
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: accept research plans on stdin without temporary-file cleanup. Target files: skills/last30days/scripts/last30days.py, tests/test_cli_v3.py, tests/test_law7_host_plan_gate.py. Added `--plan -` so the host can pass its JSON plan through a quoted stdin heredoc without creating or deleting a temporary plan file. Updated the root skill and research/comparison instructions to use that route. (Ref: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1347)
